cards.prompt: Which gluteal muscle is the most superficial and gives the buttocks their shape?
Which gluteal muscles lie deeper and mainly stabilise the pelvis while you walk or run?
cards.answer: Gluteus Medius and Gluteus Minimus, the deeper layers that keep the pelvis steady during locomotion.

cards.prompt: The Gluteus Maximus is mainly used when strong force is needed, such as climbing or ____.
You stand on one leg and your outer hip works to keep you steady while the leg can also swing outward. Which small outer-hip muscle is helping?
cards.answer: The tensor fascia lata, which moves the leg outward and stabilises you when standing on one knee/leg.
cards.explanation: It sits on the outer side of the hip.

cards.prompt: Which one is NOT one of the three superficial-layer gluteal muscles?
cards.answer: Tensor fascia lata sits on the outer hip and is separate from the three gluteal layers.
